title: Hey Samriddhi
paragraphs: I want take this letter to appriciate you, for amazing woman you are. I want to appriciate you for how kind you are because I sure as hell know there wouldn't be anyone that would tolerate me this much. Here's where the amazing part is, you are not only kind to me but also to kind to everyone around you to everything around you.

My love, I am writing this letter to tell you how much belief I have in you and how proud I am to see you working on yourself for youself, for your family and for me. All of this will seem repitative to you but for me, I want to shout all of this to you everytime you are down. I keep saying all of this as a never ending reminder that what you are and who you are is not a mistake, it's exactly where you should me.

And more than anything in this world, I want you to know that you are an amazing amazing woman. You make me feel secure enough for me to cry, share my ugly sides, share my insecurities while making me feel like more of a man than I have ever felt. You are someone with whom I am share anything, my laughter, my sorrow, my bullshit, my boredom. You geneuinly make me happy, loved and safe. I feel at peace to have this feeling where I have a bestfriend and partner both in a single person. Thank you so much for loving me. I'll always try to be better for us. And last but not the least
